description: This file contains helper functions and type definitions for testing embedded Pi runners, including workspace setup/cleanup, configuration creation, mock data generation, and object builders for assistant messages and model configurations.

methods.name: createEmbeddedPiRunnerTestWorkspace
methods.description: Creates a temporary workspace directory structure with agent and workspace subdirectories.

methods.name: cleanupEmbeddedPiRunnerTestWorkspace
methods.description: Removes the temporary workspace directory and its contents.

methods.name: createEmbeddedPiRunnerOpenAiConfig
methods.description: Generates a mock OpenClawConfig object with specified model IDs.

methods.name: immediateEnqueue
methods.description: Executes a given async task immediately and returns its result.

methods.name: createMockUsage
methods.description: Creates a mock usage object with specified input and output token counts.

methods.name: buildEmbeddedRunnerAssistant
methods.description: Builds a mock AssistantMessage object with optional overrides.

methods.name: makeEmbeddedRunnerAttempt
methods.description: Constructs a mock EmbeddedRunAttemptResult with optional overrides.

methods.name: createResolvedEmbeddedRunnerModel
methods.description: Creates a mock model configuration object for a given provider and model ID.
